items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 1 May 2026 4:20am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 01 May 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Generally cloudy with a few showery outbreaks of rain, and the risk of coastal mist and fog developing for a time around the middle part of the day. Light to moderate southeast wind veering south-southwest this afternoon, top temperature 15°C.


##Outlook##

Bright or sunny intervals over the weekend, but a continuing risk of showery rain, perhaps becoming more persistent at times on Sunday.
